Maths from zero: little numbers, big ideas

Start with a few counters. Learn to add, take away and make equal groups through three short lessons you can play with at your own pace.

By Biel Sardà · Published 30 Sept 2026 · Suggest a correction

3 short reads · A quick quiz after each one

A little curiosity goes a long way.

Maths starts with things you can see and count. Bring a few buttons or just use the activities here. We’ll join little piles, take some away, and find out why equal groups are so useful.

There is no clock to beat. Try an idea, change something, and see what happens. These three chapters are your first steps; bigger numbers and fractions can come later.

A few words worth knowing

Add
Put amounts together to find a total.
Subtract
Find what remains when an amount is taken away.
Equal groups
Groups that each contain the same amount.
Zero
The number we use for none.
